claims.claim: 院前激活导管室组的门球时间比急诊室激活组缩短33.1分钟（95% CI 18.7–47.5）。
claims.sourceTitle: Hara K et al. Prehospital Activation of the Catheterization Laboratory Among Patients With Suspected STEMI Outside of a Hospital. Circ Rep. 2022
claims.supportQuote: The door-to-balloon time was 33.1 min shorter (95% CI from 47.5 to 18.7 min shorter) in the PH than ED activation group.
claims.uncertainty: 证据体GRADE评级为低（观察性研究，偏倚风险）

claims.claim: 院前激活组长期死亡率每1000名患者减少54例死亡（95% CI 33–71）。
claims.sourceTitle: Hara K et al. Prehospital Activation of the Catheterization Laboratory Among Patients With Suspected STEMI Outside of a Hospital. Circ Rep. 2022
claims.supportQuote: There were 54 fewer deaths per 1,000 patients (95% CI from 71 fewer to 33 fewer) among the PH than ED activation group.
claims.uncertainty: 证据体GRADE评级为极低（观察性研究，严重偏倚风险）

claims.claim: 总缺血时间是比门球时间更重要的指标，院前阶段延迟可以相当可观；ESC 2017 STEMI指南对院前12导联心电图和绕行急诊直接导管室分别给予Class IB和IC推荐。
claims.sourceTitle: Hara K et al. Prehospital Activation of the Catheterization Laboratory Among Patients With Suspected STEMI Outside of a Hospital. Circ Rep. 2022
claims.supportQuote: total ischemic time is emerging as a more appropriate indicator because it includes the prehospital phase, where delays can be substantial. ... The 2017 European Society of Cardiology guidelines for STEMI state that when a STEMI diagnosis is made in the prehospital setting, immediate activation of the cath lab, ED bypass, and direct transfer to the cath lab reduces treatment delay. Class 1B and Class 1C recommendations are given for prehospital 12-lead ECGs and ED bypass, respectively.
claims.uncertainty: ESC指南建议适用于STEMI确诊患者，不可直接外推至所有急性胸痛患者

claims.claim: FDA硝酸甘油舌下含片说明书规定15分钟内最多含服3片；若含服3片后疼痛持续或与既往不同，须立即就医。适应证限于冠状动脉疾病的心绞痛急性缓解。
claims.supportQuote: Administer one tablet under the tongue or in the buccal pouch at the first sign of an acute anginal attack. ... No more than three tablets are recommended within a 15-minute period. If the pain persists after a total of 3 tablets in a 15-minute period, or if the pain is different than is typically experienced, seek prompt medical attention.
claims.uncertainty: 低；现行FDA说明书结构化记录

claims.claim: 院前延迟转化为更长的总缺血时间是AMI预后的关键因素——总缺血时间包含院前阶段，该阶段延迟可以相当可观。
claims.sourceTitle: Hara K et al. Circ Rep. 2022
claims.supportQuote: total ischemic time is emerging as a more appropriate indicator because it includes the prehospital phase, where delays can be substantial.
claims.uncertainty: 来自系统评价讨论部分的总缺血时间概念，院前延迟的具体定量影响未直接测量

claims.claim: 对于急性胸痛，应立即拨打120，因为院前延迟直接增加心肌坏死风险和死亡率。
claims.sourceTitle: Hara K et al. Circ Rep. 2022
claims.supportQuote: total ischemic time is emerging as a more appropriate indicator because it includes the prehospital phase, where delays can be substantial. ... Prehospital activation of the cath lab and catheterization staff results in lower mortality and shorter door-to-balloon time for patients with suspected STEMI outside of hospitals.
claims.uncertainty: 证据来自STEMI患者观察性研究，适用于所有疑似ACS的急性胸痛患者的一般原则

claims.claim: 已确诊冠心病患者可含服1片硝酸甘油，但同时拨打120；5分钟后不缓解即呼叫急救，勿在继续含服期间等待。
claims.supportQuote: Administer one tablet under the tongue ... at the first sign of an acute anginal attack. One additional tablet may be administered every 5 minutes until relief is obtained. No more than three tablets are recommended within a 15-minute period. If the pain persists after a total of 3 tablets in a 15-minute period, or if the pain is different than is typically experienced, seek prompt medical attention.
claims.uncertainty: 来自FDA说明书；中国NMPA说明书规定类似

claims.claim: 不要因含服速效救心丸而延迟拨打120；该药院前自我使用的安全性和有效性未经RCT验证。
claims.sourceTitle: Hara K et al. Circ Rep. 2022
claims.supportQuote: total ischemic time is emerging as a more appropriate indicator because it includes the prehospital phase, where delays can be substantial.
claims.uncertainty: 院前延迟危害的证据确凿；速效救心丸院前RCT缺失系证据空白而非阴性结论

claims.claim: 不要以药物是否缓解判断病情——疼痛缓解不等于排除心梗，疼痛不缓解不等于确诊心梗。
claims.sourceTitle: Hara K et al. Circ Rep. 2022
claims.supportQuote: early diagnosis and reperfusion therapy are the most important steps for better prognosis.
claims.uncertainty: 该原则基于STEMI需客观诊断而非症状缓解判断的基本医学原则

claims.claim: 到院后遵从急诊评估流程：心电图、hs-cTn及必要的影像学检查。
claims.sourceTitle: Hara K et al. Circ Rep. 2022
claims.supportQuote: prehospital ECGs followed by activation of the cath lab improved clinical outcomes in STEMI patients.
claims.uncertainty: 证据来自STEMI患者；中国指南要求首份心电图10分钟内完成
